import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')

meta = json.loads((root / 'experiments/stage10/08_meta/STAGE10_META_ANALYSIS.json').read_text())
with (root / 'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv').open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(fh))

model_statuses = {model: info.get('status') for model, info in sorted(large.get('model_counts', {}).items())}
print(json.dumps({
    'token_weighted_eval_csv_rows': len(rows),
    'target_100m_y_recover_rows_from_csv': len(target_rows),
    'large_eval_summary_status': large.get('status'),
    'large_eval_evaluated_endpoint_rows': large.get('evaluated_endpoint_rows'),
    'large_eval_expected_formal_endpoint_rows': large.get('expected_formal_endpoint_rows'),
    'large_eval_total_table_rows_including_original': large.get('total_table_rows_including_original'),
    'large_eval_hard_failure_count': len(large.get('hard_failures', [])),
    'large_eval_model_statuses': model_statuses,
    'all_six_active_models_passed': len(model_statuses) == 6 and all(v == 'passed' for v in model_statuses.values()),
    'meta_gate_results': {
        'ce_selection_gate_passed': meta['gate_results'].get('ce_selection_gate_passed'),
        'model_family_gate_met': meta['gate_results'].get('model_family_gate_met'),
        'downstream_gate_status': meta['gate_results'].get('downstream_gate_status'),
        'oral_ready_gate_status': meta['gate_results'].get('oral_ready_gate_status'),
        'gate_verdict': meta['gate_results'].get('gate_verdict'),
        'closed_reasons': meta['gate_results'].get('closed_reasons'),
    },
    'meta_model_availability': meta.get('model_availability'),
}, sort_keys=True))
